title: Check yourself: Capability bloat, progressive discovery and the practice

questions.stem: A support agent can read tickets, draft replies, pay customers back and permanently close user profiles. Staff only ever read tickets and draft replies. Applying least privilege, which change reduces risk most?

options.text: Record every repayment and closure so that misuse can be audited later
options.says: Ruled out because "Logging and confirmation prompts are compensating controls", acting after the privilege exists.

options.text: Remove the repayment and closure capabilities from its configuration
options.says: The role never needs those capabilities, so removing them from the configuration removes the risk.

options.text: Keep every capability but ask for a confirmation before each repayment and closure
options.says: Ruled out for the same reason, since a confirmation means "they ask a person to carry the risk of a capability the role never needed".

options.text: Replace the agent with a larger model that follows instructions more reliably
options.says: Ruled out because "A larger model does not change what the agent is allowed to do".

origin.section: Least privilege: remove, do not watch

questions.stem: An internal agent is offered 45 capabilities from eight systems. It increasingly picks the wrong one, and the descriptions of all of them fill much of the window before the first message. Which first step fits?

options.text: Shorten every description so that the definitions take fewer tokens
options.says: Ruled out because "it trades selection quality for tokens" and leaves the tool count where it was.

options.text: Merge the capabilities into a few multi-purpose ones that take a mode argument
options.says: Ruled out because merging "hides the behaviours from the model's own choice and leaves the number of capabilities the same".

options.text: Move to a larger model so that more definitions fit in the window
options.says: Ruled out because a larger window does not cure it: "Claude's ability to pick the right tool degrades once you exceed 30–50 available tools".

options.text: Defer most definitions behind a search tool and keep the few most used loaded
options.says: With 10 or more tools and large definitions, the search tool loads on demand and the most used tools stay loaded.
